pattern_explanation: Both languages inherited these forms from Latin, but the meanings shifted over time in each language, so the similar spellings now point to different ideas.
false_friend_warning: The Portuguese verb written as 'pretender' looks like the English verb 'pretend', but it means to intend or to aim to do something. The English 'pretend' means to make believe something is true when it is not, so a learner who translates literally will say the opposite of what they mean.
